shortDescription: Flap said on X that Permissionless Launch has gone live on BNB Chain and now supports custom quote tokens. According to Odaily, users can enter a token contract address to issue tokens with one click, choose assets to create trading pairs, and add programmable mechanisms including creator wallets…

children: Flap said on X that Permissionless Launch has gone live on BNB Chain and now supports custom quote tokens. According to Odaily, users can enter a token contract address to issue tokens with one click, choose assets to create trading pairs, and add programmable mechanisms including creator wallets, dividends, burns, and liquidity.

title: Flap Launches Permissionless Launch on BNB Chain
